extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent attorneys, applicants, and other practitioners dealing with JPO patent/utility model prosecution
extracted.subtask_description: Official Examination Guidelines issued by the Japan Patent Office setting out the legal and substantive standards, procedures, and requirements for examination of patent and utility model applications in Japan. The page is an English provisional translation with links to detailed chapters (Japanese text prevails in case of ambiguity).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicable periods and applications of these Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifies which applications and time periods the Examination Guidelines apply to (e.g., guidelines effective on and after October 1, 2015; previous guidelines remain effective for examinations on or before September 30, 2015).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates transitional application of the Guidelines to different filing/examination periods; see detailed chapter for exact temporal/applicability rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling Procedures for Examinations involving Product-by-process Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and criteria for examining claims that define products by the process by which they are made (product-by-process claims).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed procedures provided in the referenced chapter — practical handling guidance for novelty, inventive step, and claim interpretation for product-by-process claim formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles of Examination and Flow of Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Overarching principles that govern the conduct and sequence of examination procedures at the JPO (e.g., order of steps, aims of examination).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the high-level framework for how examinations are conducted; see chapter for flow diagrams and examiner duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specifying Claimed Invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and criteria on how a claimed invention is to be identified and specified for the purposes of examination (interpretation of claim language, scope determination).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes rules for claim interpretation, identifying the technical features that define the invention, and mapping claims to disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Art Search and Determination of Novelty, Inventive Step, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for conducting prior art searches and the method for determining novelty and inventive step (patentability) of claimed subject matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers search strategies, how prior art is compared to claimed features, and stepwise determination of novelty and inventive step; see detailed section for examiner methodology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Reasons for Refusal
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedural requirements for issuing a Notice of Reasons for Refusal to an applicant (grounds, content, timing).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies what must be communicated to the applicant when refusal is proposed, including citation of legal grounds and factual bases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling of Written Opinion, Written Amendment, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and criteria for evaluating applicants' written opinions, written amendments to applications, and related responses during prosecution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on how amendments and written arguments are processed and assessed against statutory requirements and prior art.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision (grant/refusal) procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and criteria governing the issuance of final decisions on patentability (grant or refusal).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes procedural steps leading to decisions and standards for when a decision should be made; see chapter for formal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision of Dismissal of Amendment
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedures for dismissing proposed amendments to a patent application (i.e., when an amendment is not allowable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details grounds for dismissal and how examiners should document and communicate dismissal of amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconsideration by Examiners before Appeal Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for internal reconsideration of decisions by examiners prior to the commencement of formal appeal proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how examiners should handle requests or circumstances that merit reconsideration and the applicable timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication with Applicant and Request for Documents etc. Required for the Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for examiner communications with applicants, including requests for documents and additional information necessary for examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies what information may be requested, how requests should be framed, and how applicants’ responses affect prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enablement Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(4)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the description disclose the invention sufficiently for a person skilled in the art to carry out the invention (enablement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed guidance in the Description chapter on what constitutes sufficient disclosure, examples, and borderline cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministerial Ordinance Requirement (Description) (Patent Act Article 36(4)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional formal/ministerial-ordinance-based requirements applicable to the description under Article 36(4)(i).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies document/format formalities imposed by ministerial ordinance in addition to statutory enablement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Disclosure of Information on Prior Art Documents (Patent Act Article 36(4)(ii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligations concerning disclosure in the description of information on relevant prior art documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on what prior art information should be mentioned in the description and how it affects examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Act Article 36(5) (Requirements for Claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to statutory/formal requirements for claims under Article 36(5) (format and content requirements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Claims chapter for specifics on required elements of claim statements and formal compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that claims be supported by the description (i.e., the claimed scope must be supported by the disclosure).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extensive guidance in the Support Requirement section on how to assess whether the description supports the claimed subject matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(ii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that claims be clear and unambiguous so that the scope of protection is ascertainable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains common clarity problems, claim language pitfalls, and how to resolve ambiguous claim terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conciseness Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(iii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that claims be concise and avoid unnecessary multiplicity of claims or redundant wording.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on drafting concise claims and when multiple dependent claims may be objectionable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministerial Ordinance Requirement on Statement of Claims (Patent Act Article 36(6)(iv))
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal/ministerial-ordinance-based requirements governing the form and statement of claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies particular formalities for claim presentation mandated by ministerial rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of Invention (Patent Act Article 37)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that an application relate to one invention or a group of inventions so linked as to form a single general inventive concept (unity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance covers how to assess unity, when to require division, and examples of unity vs lack of unity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Unity of Application (historical: applied to applications on or before Dec 31, 2003)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to historical unity requirements that applied to older filings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provided as reference for legacy applications; see 'Reference' chapter for specifics relevant to pre-2004 filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for Patent and Industrial Applicability (Patent Act Article 29(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for subject-matter eligibility (what categories of inventions can be patented) and industrial applicability (utility).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on exclusions, examples of eligible/ineligible subject matter, and how to assess industrial applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty (Patent Act Article 29(1) and (2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that claimed invention be novel over prior art (not anticipated by prior disclosure).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details on how novelty is assessed, what counts as prior art, and exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive Step (Patent Act Article 29(1) and (2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the invention involve an inventive step (non-obviousness) over the prior art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Methodology and factors for assessing inventive step; includes problem-solution approaches and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure of Determining Novelty and Inventive Step
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific procedural steps and examiner methodology for assessing novelty and inventive step in examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers search, selection of closest prior art, characterization of technical problem, and obviousness analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims Including Specific Expressions
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on how to treat claims that include certain specific types of expressions (e.g., ranges, mathematical expressions, Markush groups).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains interpretive rules and special handling for particular claim formulations and expressions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptions to Lack of Novelty of Invention (Patent Act Article 30)
rubrics_metrics.description: Statutory exceptions where disclosure does not destroy novelty (e.g., certain grace periods, disclosures under specified circumstances).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists and explains the exceptions and the conditions under which they apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secret Prior Art (Patent Act Article 29bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules concerning the treatment of secret prior art (e.g., disclosures that became publicly available after a filing date or other special classes of prior art).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains what constitutes secret prior art and how it affects patentability determinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Application (Patent Act Article 39)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on the effect of prior applications (e.g., earlier-filed applications) on novelty and priority issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on double-patenting, priority claims, and the interplay between earlier applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category of Unpatentable Invention (Patent Act Article 32)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enumerates categories of subject matter that are unpatentable under statute (e.g., inventions contrary to public order/morality, methods of medical treatment may be excluded, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides examples and interpretation of statutory exclusions and how to apply them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Amendments (Patent Act Article 17bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards governing when and how amendments to description, claims, or drawings may be made during prosecution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discusses permissible scope of amendments, timing, and formal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Adding New Matter (Patent Act Article 17bis(3))
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific prohibition/criteria related to amendments that would add subject matter beyond the content of the application as filed (new matter).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details on how to detect new matter and the consequences for amendments that introduce it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Changing Special Technical Feature of Invention (Patent Act Article 17bis(4))
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules concerning amendments that change special technical features of the invention and the limits on such changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains what constitutes a prohibited change to a special technical feature and allowed modifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment for other than the Prescribed Purposes (Patent Act Article 17bis(5))
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions addressing amendments made for purposes other than those prescribed by statute (i.e., impermissible tactical/amendments).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on identifying and handling amendments made for improper purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority under the Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for claiming priority under the Paris Convention (timing, required documents, priority effects).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains claiming priority to earlier filings in other countries and relevant formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for claiming priority within filings in Japan (internal priority mechanisms).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details on conditions and procedures for internal priority claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division of Patent Application (Patent Act Article 44)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and criteria for dividing an application into multiple applications (divisionals).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes when division is permitted, formal requirements, and effects of division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Division of Patent Application (section)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific procedural and substantive requirements that must be met to effect a division of application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains allowable grounds for division and examiner treatment of divisional filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice under Article 50bis
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural requirements regarding notices issued under Article 50bis (specific statutory notice provisions tied to division/conversion).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See special application chapter for the use and effect of Article 50bis notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion of Application (Patent Act Article 46)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and criteria for converting an application from one type to another (e.g., utility model to patent or vice versa) where allowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details on how conversions are handled, timing, and substantive conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Application Based on Utility Model Registration (Patent Act Article 46bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for filing patent applications that are based on prior utility model registrations and the special rules that apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains interplay between utility model registration and subsequent patent filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference filing (Patent Act Article 38ter)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on reference filings under Article 38ter, including cross-references and related procedural mechanisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides guidance on when and how reference filings may be used and their examination implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of Foreign Language Written Application System
rubrics_metrics.description: System overview for applications filed in a foreign language (procedures, requirements, translations, time limits).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how foreign-language filings are treated, required translations, and special examination steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of Foreign Language Written Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed procedures and standards for examining applications filed in a foreign language.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extensive chapter (large PDF) addressing how examiners handle language issues, translation corrections, and evidentiary weight of translations.

rubrics_metrics.name: International Patent Application (PCT) procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on handling international patent applications (PCT) and their national phase entries in Japan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains interaction between PCT procedures and JPO examination requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension of Patent Term
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and conditions under which the term of a patent may be extended (e.g., regulatory delays, statutory provisions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes procedures for applying for extension and the substantive criteria for allowance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic Requirements for Utility Model Registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive and formal requirements for the registration of utility models in Japan (distinct from patents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers novelty/industrial applicability scope for utility models and any simplified requirements versus patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility Model Technical Opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure and standards for producing technical opinions on utility model registrations (e.g., examination-equivalent technical reports).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how technical opinions are generated and their use in the utility model system.

rubrics_metrics.name: International Relevant Provisions / Statutory References
rubrics_metrics.description: The Guidelines repeatedly refer to the relevant provisions of the Patent Act and ministerial ordinances that serve as the legal basis for each criterion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For precise legal interpretation, the Guidelines direct readers to the statutory provisions and note that the Japanese text prevails where ambiguities in translation arise.
